words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 sæd，来自原始日耳曼语 *sēdiz（撒下之物），与 sow（播种）同源
words.native_definition: the small hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows
words.core_concept: the small dry thing that holds a whole plant folded inside – 一粒干硬的小东西，里头折着一整株
words.core_image: 一粒干瘪的小东西落进土缝，几天后顶开土冒出两片嫩芽
examples: Plant the seeds in early spring.
That meeting sowed the seeds of change.
semantic_expansions: 种子/籽：里头折着一整株的那粒小东西
起因：一件事最初那粒、后来长成全局的东西

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，古英语 bridd 之后再无更早可考，无词根可拆
words.origin: 古英语 bridd（雏鸟），词源不明，非拉丁借词
words.native_definition: a creature with feathers and wings that can usually fly
words.core_concept: the light thing on the branch that leaves before your hand arrives – 枝上那个轻东西，手还没到它已经走了
words.core_image: 枝头一动，那团轻飘飘的东西已经蹿到另一棵树上
examples: A small bird landed on the sill.
Birds fly south in autumn.
semantic_expansions: 鸟/禽：带羽有翅、手还没伸到就飞开的那类活物

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 tōl，来自原始日耳曼语 *tōwlam（用来做事的器具），与 taw（加工）同源
words.native_definition: a device held in the hand and used to do a particular job
words.core_concept: the handle worn smooth by the palm that keeps reaching for it – 被同一只手掌磨得发亮的那根柄
words.core_image: 柄上那一处被手心磨得发亮，一摸就知道用了多少年
examples: He put every tool back in the box.
Language is a tool for thinking.
semantic_expansions: 工具/用具：握在手里用来做活的器械
手段：把某物当器械使的那种用法

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本义是「呼出的热气」，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 bræþ（气味、呼出的热气），来自原始日耳曼语 *brēthaz（热气）
words.native_definition: the air taken into and let out of the lungs
words.core_concept: the white cloud that shows on cold glass and then fades – 冷玻璃上现出的那团白，一会儿又散了
words.core_image: 冷玻璃上凑近一呵，现出一团白，转眼淡下去
examples: Take a deep breath and relax.
She was out of breath after the climb.
semantic_expansions: 呼吸/气息：吸进吐出的那股气
一口气：一次吐纳的分量

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 brægen，来自原始日耳曼语 *bragnam，与希腊语 brekhmos（前额）或有远亲关系
words.native_definition: the organ inside the head that controls thought and feeling
words.core_concept: the folded grey thing inside the skull where everything gets decided – 颅骨里那团盘着褶子的东西，事都在那儿定
words.core_image: 颅骨掀开，里头那团盘满褶子的东西还温着
examples: The brain uses a fifth of our energy.
Use your brain before you answer.
semantic_expansions: 大脑：颅骨里那个器官
头脑/智力：用它想事的那份能力

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本义指颈前鼓起处，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 þrote，来自原始日耳曼语 *thrut-（肿起、鼓起的部位）
words.native_definition: the passage at the front of the neck through which food and air pass
words.core_concept: the place that moves once when you swallow – 咽下去时鼓一下的那个地方
words.core_image: 水咽下去，颈前那处鼓一下又落回原样
examples: He has a sore throat today.
The words stuck in her throat.
semantic_expansions: 喉咙/咽喉：颈前供食物与空气通过的那条道
嗓子：从这条道里发出的声音

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，词源到中古英语为止，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 中古英语 chiveren，词源不确，可能与古英语 ceafl（颌）相关，形容牙关打战
words.native_definition: to shake slightly because of cold or fear
words.core_concept: the small fast shake that runs through you before you notice it – 一阵细而快的动，人还没反应它已经过去了
words.core_image: 风一穿过湿衣服，背上那阵细而快的动自己就起来了
examples: She shivered in the cold rain.
He shivered at the thought of it.
semantic_expansions: 颤抖/发抖/哆嗦：因冷或怕而起的那阵细快的动

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本义是「塞住气道」，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 ācēocian（塞住），来自原始日耳曼语，与 cheek（腮）或有关联
words.native_definition: to be unable to breathe because the throat is blocked
words.core_concept: the moment the way in shuts and nothing gets past – 通道一下合上，什么也过不去那一刻
words.core_image: 一口卡在半途，脸涨红，手往喉前抓
examples: He choked on a fish bone.
Weeds choked the narrow stream.
semantic_expansions: 窒息/呛住：气道被塞住、过不去气
堵塞：同一个「塞住使不通」用在通道上

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 āþ，来自原始日耳曼语 *aithaz（郑重之言）
words.native_definition: a formal promise, often made in public or in court
words.core_concept: the hand raised and held there while the words come out – 手举起来不放下，话就在那姿势里说出口
words.core_image: 他一手按在书上，另一手举着不放，一字一句说完
examples: She took an oath to tell the truth.
He muttered an oath under his breath.
semantic_expansions: 誓言/宣誓：郑重当众说定的那番话
咒骂：借神明之名出口的那种话，同源另一支用法

words.decomposable_note: 词源虽可溯至拉丁 follis（空袋），但英语中 fool 已无同族词可迁移，按不可拆处理
words.origin: 古法语 fol（疯子、小丑）← 晚期拉丁语 follis（风箱、空袋），但英语已不作词根用
words.native_definition: a person who behaves in a silly or unwise way
words.core_concept: the one everyone else has already seen through, still going – 旁人早看穿了、他还在往下演的那个
words.core_image: 满屋人都憋着笑，只有他还认真往下说
examples: Do not be a fool about money.
They made a fool of him.
semantic_expansions: 傻瓜/愚人：行事不明智、被旁人看穿的那个
上当者：因此被人耍了的那个

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 hafoc，来自原始日耳曼语 *habukaz（猛禽）
words.native_definition: a bird of prey with sharp eyes and curved claws
words.core_concept: the shape that hangs still high up, then drops all at once – 高处悬着不动的那个影子，忽然一头扎下来
words.core_image: 高处那影子悬了半天不动，一收翅直扎下去
examples: A hawk circled above the field.
The hawks in cabinet urged action.
semantic_expansions: 鹰/隼：目锐爪弯、悬空俯冲的猛禽
主战派：政见上像它一样主张下扑的那些人

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本义是「转暗」，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 dox（暗色的），来自原始日耳曼语 *dusk-（发暗）
words.native_definition: the time of day when the light is nearly gone
words.core_concept: the hour you stop being able to tell colours apart – 到这会儿，颜色彼此就分不出来了
words.core_image: 屋里没开灯，书页上的字一行行糊成一片
examples: The lamps come on at dusk.
They walked home in the dusk.
semantic_expansions: 黄昏/暮色/薄暮：光将尽、颜色分不出来的那一段时候
